text: dsh-account-balance 是面向 DSH Web 侧边栏的账户菜单插件，在头像菜单中展示 DeepSeek 充值余额与累计消费，并保留设置、反馈和登录入口。浏览器界面通过宿主路由读取账户摘要，菜单打开或窗口回到前台时刷新；读取失败时保留上次金额并提供重试。适合想在工作区快速查看账户用量的人，需要已登录的 DeepSeek 账户。

dsh-account-balance shows recharge balance and cumulative spend in the DSH Web sidebar account menu. It refreshes account data through a host route when opened or when the window regains focus, and offers retry after read failures. Requires a signed-in DeepSeek account.
想在 DSH 侧边栏账户菜单里直接看到 DeepSeek 余额和累计消费。
每次打开账户菜单时，帮我更新一下充值余额和平台累计花费。
Show my recharge balance and cumulative DeepSeek spend in the DSH account menu.
dsh-account-balance 的功能「账户金额概览」：在侧边栏账户菜单显示充值钱包余额与累计消费金额，并在菜单打开或窗口回到前台时读取更新。
dsh-account-balance 的功能「账户菜单登录操作」：菜单保留设置和反馈入口，并按登录状态提供登录或退出；读取失败时保留已有金额并可手动重试。
dsh-account-balance 使用前须知：宿主会用已登录账户授权向当前 DeepSeek Platform 来源读取余额与累计消费摘要；插件代码不要求单独配置 API key。

dsh-account-balance README · dsh-account-balance：[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that puts your DeepSeek account's **recharge balance** and **cumulative Platform spend** into the sidebar account menu — the one that opens when you click the avatar at the bottom left, so you can check your credit without opening the billing site.

dsh-account-balance README · dsh-account-balance：```text
click the avatar at the bottom left
┌──────────────────────────┐
│ 余额              ¥4.57  │  ← added by this plugin
│ 累计消费         ¥19.69  │  ← added by this plugin

The labels follow the UI language; the screenshot text above is the Chinese UI.

dsh-account-balance README · What it does：| State | Launcher and menu |
|---|---|
| Signed in | `余额` (recharge wallets) and `累计消费` (cumulative Platform spend) above the shipped rows |
| Signed out | The shipped "More" row, and the third row becomes `登录` (sign in) |
| Read failed | Keeps the last known amounts and appends an error line with `重试` / Retry |
| Pending sign-in | The menu shows the authorization link with copy / open actions and waits for the grant to land |

dsh-account-balance README · What it does：The figures are re-read **whenever the menu opens** and whenever the window comes back to the foreground (`visibilitychange` / `focus`). Nothing polls.

Amounts use the same display rules as the Platform Web UI: two decimals, digit grouping, truncation for positive values, half-up rounding for negative ones, and a `<¥0.01` form below one cent. Styling references only `--dsw-*` theme tokens, so light and dark follow the app.

dsh-account-balance README · Where the numbers come from：The shipped `deepseekAccount.getBalance()` parses the Platform response through a `z.object`, which **strips every field it does not name** — leaving only `normal_wallets` and `bonus_wallets`. The same response already carries the cumulative spend:

dsh-account-balance README · Where the numbers come from：`total_costs` is what this plugin adds. Because the account grant is Host-only — `deepseekAccount.getPlatformSession()` returns the origin, the token and the deployment headers and is deliberately not Remote-exposed — the browser half cannot read the summary itself. So the Host half issues that one request, byte-for-byte the same one `dsh-deepseek-account-platform` issues: same origin, same deployment headers, same `x-dsh-auth-token`, `GET`, no body.
dsh-account-balance README · Where the numbers come from：The Host half only reads: it never writes Platform state, and the token never leaves the Host process.

dsh-account-balance README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness **Desktop** with a signed-in DeepSeek account (`ui-settings-account` enabled).
- Verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` on macOS.

dsh-account-balance README · 1. Get the package：```bash
git clone https://github.com/ShawnShang-1/dsh-account-balance.git ~/code/dsh-account-balance
```

dsh-account-balance README · 2. Install it as a profile bundle：Ask the Harness agent to run:

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle  target: /Users/you/code/dsh-account-balance
```

or, with the CLI on the `PATH`:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile "$DSH_PROFILE" add ~/code/dsh-account-balance
```

Either way the package declares both halves — `dsh.bundle.patch` for the Host row and `dsh.client` for the browser bundle — so one install adds both. The install applies live through HMR; if the sidebar does not change, reload the page (`Cmd`/`Ctrl` + `R`).
section: 2. Install it as a profile bundle

text:
dsh-account-balance README · 3. Verify：Open the account menu: the two amount rows should sit above `设置 / 意见反馈 / 退出登录`.

To check the Host half without the UI, the route answers `401` when it is mounted and behind the browser trust fence (an unmounted prefix falls through to `405`):

```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{}' \
  http://127.0.0.1:19387/dsh-account-balance/overview

dsh-account-balance README · Configuration：Edit the plugin's row in your profile `cordis.patch.yml`, or pass the values at install time:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `ttlMs` | `15000` | How long one read is served from the Host cache before the next read goes to the Platform. `0` reads every time. |
| `timeoutMs` | `15000` | Platform request deadline. |

```yaml
- id: account-balance
  name: './lib/entry.js'
  config:
    ttlMs: 15000

dsh-account-balance README · Uninstall, or hand the launcher back：Remove the whole plugin:

```text
plugin_manager remove_bundle dsh-account-balance
```

Or keep the plugin but give the account menu back to the shipped plugin: set `LAUNCHER_PRIORITY` in [`client.js`](client.js) from `-1` to `1` and reload the page.
section: Uninstall, or hand the launcher back

text:
dsh-account-balance README · How it works：| Half | File | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Host entry | [`lib/entry.js`](lib/entry.js) | The Loader row's stable module. Re-imports `lib/host.js` by file revision, so Host edits take effect on the next activation without restarting the app. The row's specifier points at this file (`./lib/entry.js`) rather than the package name, which is what makes that path possible. |
| Host | [`lib/host.js`](lib/host.js) | Reads the Platform summary with the stored grant and answers the page over one `/dsh-account-balance` prefix route on the composed webserver. The route admits through `ctx.connection.admit`, so it inherits the browser trust fence. Cached for `ttlMs`. |
| Browser | [`client.js`](client.js) | The prebuilt Client bundle. Registers into `settings.launcher` and renders the launcher and its menu. |
| Compat | [`index.js`](index.js) | `export * from './lib/entry.js'`, so importing the package by name still works. |

section: Why it takes the seat instead of adding to it

text: dsh-account-balance README · Why it takes the seat instead of adding to it：So `priority: -1` takes the seat and `priority: 1` hands it straight back. The trigger geometry and the menu surface are the shipped `AccountMenu.module.css` and the shared `Menu.module.css` rewritten under this plugin's class prefix; no Harness Client package (such as `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`) is imported.
section: Why it takes the seat instead of adding to it

text:
dsh-account-balance README · What the shipped plugin still owns：`ui-settings-account` keeps every registration that is independent of the launcher, and none of them are affected:

- **Settings → Account** page (`settings.section`) — login state, balance card, usage and top-up links.
- **Desktop onboarding, top-up and usage page host** (`shell.overlay`).
- **Quota notice** (`shell.quota-notice`).
- **Model sign-in choice** (`settings.models.sign-in`).
section: What the shipped plugin still owns

text: dsh-account-balance README · What the shipped plugin still owns：Only three notifications live inside the shadowed component: the granted-bonus card, and the credential-expired and model-sign-in-required toasts. Sign-out confirmation is likewise simplified from "query running tasks, then a dialog" to one confirm step inside this menu.
section: What the shipped plugin still owns

text:
dsh-account-balance README · Known limitations：- **It shadows shipped UI.** The three notifications listed above no longer appear while the plugin is installed. A future DSH release that restructures the launcher will need this plugin updated.
- `CLIENT_VERSION` (`0.2.0-rc.2`) is hard-coded as the `x-client-version` request header. Shipped bundles inline that constant at build time; a hand-written bundle carries the version it was authored against. It is a request-header string only.
- Only the **recharge balance** and **cumulative spend** are shown. `bonus_wallets` (granted credit) is deliberately not displayed.
- `累计消费` is whatever the Platform reports as `total_costs`; if that field's meaning changes, the plugin shows the number the Platform gives.
